subject.title: fix(openai): align auth availability with effective routes

question: Should provider route-resolution and harness transport-compatibility facts become a supported permanent Plugin SDK contract in this PR?
rationale: The implementation fixes a real routing bug but also creates a long-term external API promise and changes implicit OpenAI runtime selection; tests cannot authorize that product and compatibility direction.

options.title: Approve after compatibility repairs
options.body: Keep the public contract, fix every regression, and require focused upgrade and contract proof before merge.

options.title: Internalize the route facts
options.body: Retain the OpenAI correction behind bundled internal surfaces until a narrower external plugin API is separately approved.

options.title: Pause the broad migration
options.body: Replace this branch with a smaller compatibility-preserving fix if the permanent public contract is not desired.

recommendation.title: Approve after compatibility repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the public contract, fix every regression, and require focused upgrade and contract proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: His merged history covers the OpenAI/Codex authentication and Plugin SDK surfaces affected by this decision.
